name: Beached Sea Turtle
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago.  It has been scavenged by the murlocs who have encamped themselves around the creature's remains.  Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
narrative.objectives: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
narrative.offerRewardText: Another discovery for us to research - well done adventurer!  These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus.  Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello adventurer - do you have any discoveries of creatures that have washed ashore to report on?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 13 to 14, 2,110 XP in all.

quests.name: Washed Ashore
quests.objectiveText: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

quests.name: Washed Ashore
quests.objectiveText: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.

quests.name: Beached Sea Turtle
quests.objectiveText: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
